summary: Extends the IMAP command for listing mailboxes so that one extensible LIST command can carry options and return extra information. Previously each extension needed its own special list command, and combining extensions was awkward. This standards-track document gives clients a single, consistent way to ask for lists of mailboxes with added details.

eli5.summary: Imagine asking a librarian for a list of shelves. Before, you needed a different form for each kind of question. Now there is one form with checkboxes, so you can ask for exactly what you want at once.

questions: how to list mailboxes with options in imap
